news.title: Watch Valentin Barco’s first Chelsea interview!
news.title_zh: 观看瓦伦丁·巴科 (Valentin Barco) 的首次切尔西采访！
news.body_en: Valentin Barco has given his first interview as a Chelsea player and you can watch it for free now! Barco completed a transfer from Strasbourg to Chelsea earlier this month and joined up with his new team-mates at Cobham last week following Argentina’s run to the final of the FIFA World Cup. We caught up with the 22-year-old a few days into life as a Chelsea player to ask him how he’s getting on and why he decided to make the move to Stamford Bridge. ‘I’m very happy to be here and to play for this club,’ says Barco in the interview, which you can watch for free below by simply signing in to your account. ‘Chelsea are one of the best clubs in the world. If they are calling you, you have to say yes. It was a top step to come back to the Premier League. ‘The first week was so good. The quality, the intensity, the training has been top. It’s a dream to play for Chelsea.’ During the interview, Barco discusses his relationship with Xabi Alonso, reveals what he is like off the pitch and offers a message to Chelsea fans. He also lists his best attributes and explains why his move from left-back into central midfield during his season at Strasbourg was such a profound development in his footballing journey. ‘It helped me a lot to play again, to be important in the team, to come back to the national team and go to the World Cup, and now to come back to the Premier League,’ says Barco. ‘I feel comfortable playing as a midfielder. I love it because you touch the ball so much. You have to control the tempo of the game. I learned so much how to play as a midfielder, the timings, the tactics. The time was so important for my career and for my life as well.’

news.title: Alfie Osborne joins Chelsea
news.title_zh: 阿尔菲·奥斯本加盟切尔西
news.body_en: Chelsea Football Club is pleased to announce the signing of Alfie Osborne, with the 18-year-old putting pen to paper on a contract with the Blues until 2030. The teenager joins the club from Scottish side Hearts, where he won their B team’s Player of the Year and Players’ Player of the Year awards for 2025/26. After switching from midfield to centre-back last season, Osborne captained Hearts’ Under-18s side to glory in the Scottish FA Youth Cup final. He also played 28 times for Hearts B in the Lowland Football League, the fifth tier of senior football in Scotland. Osborne has represented Scotland several times at youth level, most recently captaining his country in qualifying for the UEFA European Under-19 Championship.
news.body_zh: 切尔西足球俱乐部很高兴地宣布签下阿尔菲·奥斯本，这位 18 岁的球员与蓝军签订了一份到 2030 年的合同。这位少年从苏格兰球队哈茨加盟俱乐部，在那里他赢得了他们 B 队的 2025/26 赛季年度最佳球员和球员评选的年度最佳球员奖。上赛季从中场转为中后卫后，奥斯本带领哈茨队的 U-18 队在苏格兰青年足总杯决赛中夺得冠军。他还为Hearts B 队在苏格兰第五级别的低地足球联赛中出场28 次。奥斯本曾多次代表苏格兰青年队参加比赛，最近一次作为队长参加了欧洲 19 岁以下锦标赛的预选赛。

news.title: Chelsea squad numbers confirmed for the 2026/27 season
news.title_zh: 切尔西 2026/27 赛季阵容确认
news.body_en: The Chelsea squad numbers for the 2026/27 campaign have today been confirmed. Striker Joao Pedro has switched to the No.9 shirt, having been named the club’s Player of the Year last season. Wesley Fofana has also changed number, with the Frenchman now set to wear the No.3 shirt for the upcoming campaign. Summer signing Morgan Rogers was announced as the Blues' new No.17 following his arrival back in July. Marco Palestra, Valentin Barco and Maxence Lacroix have been handed two, four and five shirts respectively. Jordan Henderson is to take the No.14 shirt, Danny Welbeck will wear No.18, Emmanuel Emegha the No.22, Geovany Quenda the No.23 and Pep Chavarria the No.29. With our squad numbers confirmed, Blues supporters can now customise and purchase their shirt for the forthcoming campaign, which begins with a trip to Fulham next Monday, by clicking here.

news.title: FPL 2026/27: Xabi Alonso's impact
news.title_zh: FPL 2026/27：哈维·阿隆索的影响
news.body_en: Chelsea have teamed up with Fantasy Football Scout to help bring you hints, tips and advice during the 2026/27 Fantasy Premier League (FPL) season. Scout will be using their expertise to provide advice and gameweek tips, which should prove useful in ensuring you win your mini-leagues. One of the most significant takeaways from Chelsea’s pre-season was the three-at-the-back formation that Alonso opted for in each of the Blues’ last three warm-up fixtures. Seeing Chelsea with three at the back, it's hard not to be reminded of Antonio Conte’s 2017 title-winning side and the attacking threat Marcos Alonso and Victor Moses provided from wing-back. New signings Marco Palestra (£5.5m) and Pep Chavarria (£5.0m) are two players to watch in this regard. The Italian in particular has caught the eye in pre-season by getting into some very advanced positions. This formation could also benefit new signing Maxence Lacroix (£6.0m), who thrived in Fantasy last season playing the middle of a back-three at Crystal Palace. This is the position that the Frenchman played against Real Sociedad at Stamford Bridge. If Alonso opts to play 3-4-3 in the majority of fixtures, Lacroix could prove value for money, despite being £1.0m more expensive than Levi Colwill (£5.0m). Only two defenders notched more Defensive Contribution points than Lacroix last season. If the Blues’ most recent friendly is anything to go by, then two players in Alonso’s midfield  pivot will have plenty of routes to Fantasy points this season. Likely starter Moises Caicedo (£5.5m) racked up 10 defensive contributions in the 76 minutes he played. The Ecuador international also demonstrated his attacking threat on the pre-season tour, notching a goal and an assist from a corner. His partner last weekend was Reece James (£5.5m), who impressed in the middle of the park, picking up an assist and making two key passes. One player seemingly loving life under Alonso is Joao Pedro (£7.5m). The Brazilian has bounced back from his World Cup omission with seven goals and two assists in just five pre-season matches. After his hat-trick in our first game in Australia, Alonso spoke about how 'he’s very hungry' and 'determined to have a good season' once again. With Cole Palmer (£9.5m) and Morgan Rogers (£7.5m) potentially lining up behind him in the two number 10 positions, expect the former Brighton man to have plenty of goal scoring opportunities.
news.body_zh: 切尔西已与 Fantasy Football Scout 合作，帮助您在 2026/27 Fantasy Premier League (FPL) 赛季期间为您提供提示、技巧和建议。球探将利用他们的专业知识提供建议和比赛周技巧，这对确保您赢得迷你联赛很有用。切尔西季前赛最重要的收获之一是阿隆索在蓝军最近三场热身赛中都选择了三后卫阵型。看到切尔西的三后卫，很难不让人想起安东尼奥·孔蒂2017年夺冠的球队，以及边后卫马科斯·阿隆索和维克托·摩西提供的进攻威胁。新签约的马科·帕莱斯特拉（Marco Palestra，550万英镑）和佩普·查瓦里亚（Pep Chavarria，500万英镑）是这方面值得关注的两名球员。意大利人在季前赛中尤其引人注目，他进入了一些非常靠前的位置。这种阵型也可能让新加盟的马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦（Maxence Lacroix，600万英镑）受益，他上赛季在水晶宫踢三后卫中锋，在幻想队中表现出色。这是法国人在斯坦福桥对阵皇家社会队时所踢的位置。如果阿隆索选择在大多数比赛中打3-4-3阵型，拉克鲁瓦可能会证明物有所值，尽管它比利维·科尔威尔（500万英镑）贵100万英镑。上赛季只有两名后卫的防守贡献分超过拉克鲁瓦。如果蓝军最近的一场友谊赛可以作为参考的话，那么阿隆索中场的两名球员本赛季将有很多途径获得梦幻积分。有望首发的莫伊塞斯·凯塞多（Moises Caicedo，550万英镑）在上场76分钟内贡献了10次防守贡献。这位厄瓜多尔国脚在季前赛中也展现了他的进攻威胁，打进一球并助攻一次角球。上周末他的搭档是里斯·詹姆斯（Reece James，550万英镑），他在中场表现出色，送出了一次助攻并完成了两次关键传球。若昂·佩德罗（Joao Pedro）（750万英镑）是一位看似热爱阿隆索麾下生活的球员。巴西人从缺席世界杯的阴影中恢复过来，在仅仅五场季前赛中就打进了七粒进球和两次助攻。在澳大利亚的第一场比赛中上演帽子戏法后，阿隆索谈到了“他非常饥饿”和“决心再次度过一个美好的赛季”。科尔·帕尔默（950万英镑）和摩根·罗杰斯（750万英镑）可能排在他身后的两个10号位置上，预计这位前布莱顿球员将有很多进球机会。

news.title: Under-18s report: Chelsea 2-3 Norwich City
news.title_zh: 18岁以下青年队报告：切尔西2-3诺维奇
news.body_en: Chelsea Under-18s began the 2026/27 season with a narrow defeat at Cobham, as Norwich City came from behind in the second half to secure a 3-2 victory in our opening Under-18 Premier League fixture. The young Blues made the breakthrough during the first half through Eden Mahoney-Smith, who capitalised on a mix-up in the Norwich defence to give Chelsea the lead after 19 minutes. We took that advantage into half-time, although Norwich had threatened shortly before the interval when Henry Edwards fired over the crossbar. The visitors responded quickly after the restart, with Kahlil Steele equalising before the Norwich forward took centre stage. He won and converted a penalty to put the Canaries ahead, then completed his hat-trick with an impressive free-kick into the far corner. Chelsea continued to battle and gave ourselves hope late on when Jack Anderson's effort took a deflection on its way into the Norwich net. However, despite pushing for an equaliser in the closing stages, the young Blues were unable to find a third and Norwich held on to take all three points. Chelsea went into our first competitive fixture of the new campaign looking to make a positive start at Cobham, and the opening goal arrived midway through the first period. A long ball forward looked as though it would be dealt with comfortably by the Norwich defence, but a misunderstanding between defender Ollie Oldfield and goalkeeper Lucas Alvarado presented Mahoney-Smith with an unexpected opportunity. With both Norwich players caught out, the Chelsea forward was left completely unchallenged and raced through towards an empty goal. He kept his composure to roll the ball into the net and give us a 1-0 lead after 19 minutes. It was one of the more straightforward finishes Mahoney-Smith is likely to have this season, but his alertness to anticipate the mistake ensured the opportunity did not go to waste. Norwich remained in the contest and began to pose a greater threat as the first half progressed. Their best opportunity to draw level before the break fell to Edwards, who found space in a promising position but sent his effort over the crossbar. That meant Chelsea headed into the interval with our one-goal advantage intact and 45 minutes away from beginning the new league campaign with a victory. The complexion of the game changed quickly following the restart. Four minutes into the second half, Steele found the equaliser for Norwich, bringing the visitors level at 1-1 and giving them renewed momentum. Chelsea almost regained the lead when substitute Isaac Badu rattled the crossbar with a powerful strike. But Steele continued to cause problems as the half wore on and was involved again when the Canaries were awarded a penalty. Steele had won the spot-kick himself and stepped forward to take responsibility from 12 yards, converting to complete the turnaround and put Norwich 2-1 ahead after 71 minutes. Chelsea were now searching for a response, but instead it was the visitors who struck again eight minutes later. Norwich won a free-kick in a dangerous position and Steele completed his hat-trick in impressive fashion, producing a well-taken set-piece which found the far corner and left Chelsea facing a two-goal deficit with a little over 10 minutes remaining. The young Blues refused to give in and quickly set about trying to find a way back into the contest. That persistence was rewarded in the 83rd minute. Anderson took aim towards the Norwich goal and his effort picked up a deflection which sent the ball beyond the goalkeeper and into the net. It reduced Norwich's advantage to 3-2 and gave Chelsea renewed belief heading into the closing stages. With the deficit back to a single goal, we pushed forward in search of an equaliser and attempted to apply pressure to the Norwich defence during the remaining minutes, with Mahoney-Smith shooting just wide in the final minutes. Our Under-18s will be back in action on Saturday when we travel to Birmingham City for a U18 Premier League clash, which will once again be shown live on CFC+. news.body_zh: 切尔西 U-18 队在 2026/27 赛季开始之际，以微弱优势输给科巴姆，诺维奇城在下半场后来居上，在我们的 U-18 英超首场比赛中以 3-2 获胜。年轻的蓝军在上半场通过艾登·马奥尼·史密斯取得突破，他利用诺维奇防守的混乱，在第 19 分钟后帮助切尔西取得领先。尽管诺维奇在中场休息前不久亨利·爱德华兹的射门高出横梁，但我们还是将这一优势带入了半场。比赛重新开始后，客队迅速做出反应，卡里尔·斯蒂尔扳平比分，随后这位诺维奇前锋登上了舞台中央。他赢得了比赛，并罚入点球，帮助加那利队取得领先，然后以一记令人印象深刻的任意球射入远角，完成了帽子戏法。切尔西继续战斗，并在最后时刻杰克·安德森的射门偏转进入诺维奇的球门，这给了我们希望。然而，尽管在最后阶段力争扳平比分，年轻的蓝军却未能取得第三分，诺维奇最终全取三分。切尔西进入了新赛季的第一场比赛，希望在科巴姆取得一个积极的开局，并且在第一节中段就取得了首个进球。一个长传前锋看起来诺维奇的防守可以轻松应对，但后卫奥利·奥德菲尔德和门将卢卡斯·阿尔瓦拉多之间的误解给马奥尼·史密斯带来了一个意想不到的机会。由于诺维奇的两名球员都陷入困境，切尔西前锋完全没有受到任何挑战，并冲向空门。 19分钟后，他保持镇静，将球送入球网，帮助我们1-0领先。这是马奥尼·史密斯本赛季可能完成的更直接的比赛之一，但他对错误的预见性确保了机会没有浪费。诺维奇仍然留在比赛中，并随着上半场的进展开始构成更大的威胁。中场休息前扳平比分的最佳机会落在了爱德华兹身上，他在一个有希望的位置找到了空间，但射门却高出了横梁。这意味着切尔西在进入中场休息时保持一球优势，距离新赛季联赛的胜利还有 45 分钟。比赛重新开始后，脸色迅速发生了变化。下半场开始四分钟，斯蒂尔为诺维奇扳平比分，将客队1-1扳平，给他们带来了新的动力。当替补出场的艾萨克·巴杜以一记强力射门击中横梁时，切尔西几乎重新领先。但斯蒂尔在下半场继续制造麻烦，并在金丝雀获得点球时再次参与其中。第71分钟，斯蒂尔亲自赢得点球，并在12码处上前主罚，完成逆转，诺维奇2-1领先。切尔西现在正在寻求回应，但八分钟后客队再次发起进攻。诺维奇在危险的位置赢得了任意球，斯蒂尔以令人印象深刻的方式完成了他的帽子戏法，他漂亮的定位球找到了远角，让切尔西在比赛还剩10多分钟时面临两球落后的局面。年轻的蓝军拒绝屈服，并迅速开始寻找重返比赛的方法。这种坚持在第 83 分钟得到了回报。安德森瞄准诺维奇的球门，他的射门发生偏转，皮球越过门将入网。这将诺维奇的优势缩小到3-2，并让切尔西在进入最后阶段时重拾信心。当比分落后到一球时，我们向前推进，寻找扳平比分的机会，并试图在剩下的时间里向诺维奇的防守施加压力，马奥尼-史密斯在最后几分钟的射门稍稍偏出。我们的 18 岁以下青年队将于周六重返赛场，届时我们将前往伯明翰市参加 U18 英超联赛的比赛，这场比赛将再次在 CFC+ 上直播。单击此处，只需 14.99 英镑即可注册整个赛季。 切尔西：艾萨克·科林森、莱利·埃博（加布里埃尔·桑布 81）、乔什·亨利（尤努斯·林顿 82）、雅各布·霍尔、伊萨戈·席尔瓦、雅各布·达科（杰克·安德森 80）、伊登·马奥尼-史密斯、艾萨克·麦吉尔瓦里（艾萨克·巴杜 58）；安德鲁·彭尼（Kwamina Ampah 75），赫泽·格里姆韦德，特雷·法罗莫-阿德巴约未使用的替补：杰克·穆雷，伊曼纽尔·艾因德得分者：马奥尼·史密斯19，安德森83黄牌：39号大厅诺维奇城：卢卡斯·阿尔瓦拉多，杰克·格洛索普（艾萨克·斯坦森43），奥利·奥德菲尔德，塞缪尔·奥古斯托，杰登Munikwa (Ademidire Akarakiri 69)、Jeremiah Sinclair-Brown、Aaron Goodson (Joseph Kipa 61)、Reece Wilkes、Ollie Roberson (Jack Duffy 61)、Kahlil Steele、Henry Edwards (Hugo Collins 61)未上场替补：William Bullen、Bobby Crane得分手：Steele 49、71（笔）、 79张黄牌：奥古斯托 15、斯蒂尔 67、柯林斯 90+2

news.title: New contract and loan for Katie Cox
news.title_zh: 凯蒂·考克斯的新合同和贷款
news.body_en:
Goalkeeper Katie Cox has committed her future to Chelsea by signing a new three-year contract and will now head out on loan to Nottingham Forest for the 2026/27 season.
 Cox has been with the Blues since the age of eight, impressing while graduating through our Academy system. In 2022 she won the FA Youth Cup and was named Chelsea Women’s Academy Player of the Year two years later. After featuring as an unused substitute for the senior team on several occasions, the 20-year-old spent the 2025/26 season on loan in Scotland with Aberdeen, where she quickly established herself as first choice between the posts, featuring in 23 of their 26 league fixtures. Upon signing her new deal, the goalkeeper said: ‘I’m delighted to be able to continue my future at Chelsea and be offered another contract at my childhood club. It's a great opportunity to continue developing and keep learning from the best players and coaches in the world. ‘I want to keep learning, stay down-to-earth and be humble. I want to give a massive thanks to my parents for supporting me, especially over the last year while I've been so far away from home. ‘I’d also like to thank Phil (Radley) and Sonia (Bompastor) for putting their trust and belief in me and for seeing me as a part of the future at this club.’ Cox has also represented England from Under-16s to Under-23s level, being part of the squad which reached the semi-finals of the UEFA Women’s European Under-19 Championship in 2024. She will be joining a Nottingham Forest side who finished seventh in their first season in WSL 2, having won National League North during the 2024/25 campaign.

news.title: Pre-Season Briefing 2026/27 part three: New rules and regs

news.body_en: In the next instalment of our preview series looking ahead to the new campaign, club historian Rick Glanvill details which changes to the laws of the game the Premier League have adopted for 2026/27… As already witnessed at the World Cup, players must leave the field for one minute after receiving treatment, up from the previous 30 seconds. No more than five seconds must elapse before the taking of a goal-kick or throw-in, with possession awarded to the other team should this not be adhered to. Substitutes are now permitted just ten seconds to leave the field of play at the nearest point. Failure to do so will result in the replacement player being delayed until the next stoppage after one minute has passed. The VAR system can now review incidents where second yellow cards have led to a red card. The Premier League has decided against allowing VAR staff to overturn incorrectly-awarded corners. In the Carabao Cup, a player moving during the winter transfer window may not play for one club in the first leg of the semi-final and another in the second, but may represent their new club in the final. Loan players no longer need written permission from their parent club in order to play in the competition. - The penultimate part of our Pre-Season Briefing tomorrow will look at Chelsea player stats...

news.title: Morgan Rogers on versatility, playing with Cole Palmer and why ‘pressure brings excitement’
news.title_zh: 摩根·罗杰斯谈多才多艺、与科尔·帕尔默一起打球以及为什么“压力带来兴奋”
news.body_en: Saturday’s game against Real Sociedad at Stamford Bridge gave Chelsea supporters a first glimpse of Morgan Rogers and Cole Palmer playing side by side. It is a thrilling prospect. The attacking duo, great mates of course, lined up in adjacent number ten roles behind Joao Pedro. The positional fluidity Xabi Alonso affords to his team meant Rogers, Palmer and Joao Pedro were regularly popping up all over the park. Indeed, if you look at our opening goal on Saturday, Rogers and Joao Pedro are in central striking positions ready to attack Pedro Neto’s inswinging cross. The Brazilian meets it, with Rogers on hand to gobble up the loose ball and open his Blues account. Rogers was nominally positioned on the left of that trio, but for the goal had manoeuvred himself to the right of Joao Pedro, with Palmer lurking behind them. It was an early example of how Rogers and Palmer work in tandem. They may be ostensibly similar players who play in similar positions, but Rogers knows the key to making the most of his and Palmer’s varied assets. ‘By helping each other,’ he says. ‘We have different qualities, different ways of playing the game and affecting games. Playing off each other and helping each other's strengths and weaknesses can work. ‘We do a lot of things that are different. Ultimately, it's about scoring and creating and linking the game. We do that in our own different ways. ‘And even if it might be more of a game suited for one than the other, we can still have our impact. It's about helping each other with the rest of the team, learning off each other and trying to get the best version of Chelsea as possible.’ That attitude is central to Rogers’ thinking about his own role, too. We have seen him thrive during his time at Aston Villa in different positions: as a number ten, an eight, and on the flanks. Wherever Alonso chooses to deploy him in Chelsea blue, Rogers is solely focused on maximising his output for the greater good. ‘I can play in a number of positions and that's probably a strength of mine,’ says the 24-year-old. ‘I can adapt and give managers a different outlook on different positions. I've always grown up being that way. Understanding the game and learning the game and enjoying it and loving it as much as I do, I never wanted to be bogged down to one position or one attribute. Being versatile helps me. Rogers adds: ‘It's a team game, it's 11 players on the pitch, and whatever role I'm given and whatever the manager and other players want from me, I'm going to do to the best of my ability. I’m not a player that gets bogged down having to be the guy to score or assist. ‘As long as I'm contributing and creating and providing or doing whatever's necessary to score and to win, that's all I care about.’ As one of the most eye-catching transfers of the summer so far, Rogers’ move from the West Midlands to west London inevitably comes with additional expectations, particularly from outside observers. Rogers is calm at that prospect, though, and ready to meet the challenge head-on. ‘Pressure brings excitement,’ he says. ‘I think if you're not playing for anything, that excitement, that buzz, that feeling, isn't there. To play with that pressure and that feeling is only going to help. ‘I'm looking forward to it. I'm excited. I let other people talk about stuff like that off the pitch. 'I'm just going to show what I can do on the pitch and why I'm here and why I should be here, and how I can influence and help the team and impact games. That’s all I'm here to do.’ We don’t have long to wait now until we see Rogers put that perspective into practice.
news.body_zh: 周六在斯坦福桥对阵皇家社会队的比赛让切尔西球迷第一次看到摩根·罗杰斯和科尔·帕尔默并肩作战。这是一个令人兴奋的前景。这对进攻二人组当然是伟大的搭档，在若昂·佩德罗身后排列着相邻的十号位置。哈比·阿隆索为他的球队提供的位置流动性意味着罗杰斯、帕尔默和若昂·佩德罗经常出现在公园各处。事实上，如果你看看我们周六的首个进球，就会发现罗杰斯和若昂·佩德罗处于中锋位置，准备攻击佩德罗·内托的内旋传中。巴西人迎战了比赛，罗杰斯在场，吞下掉球并打开了他的蓝军账户。罗杰斯名义上位于三人组的左侧，但为了进球，他将自己移至若昂·佩德罗的右侧，而帕尔默则潜伏在他们身后。这是罗杰斯和帕尔默合作的早期例子。他们表面上可能是相似的球员，踢相似的位置，但罗杰斯知道充分利用他和帕尔默不同资产的关键。 “通过互相帮助，”他说。 “我们有不同的品质、不同的比赛方式以及影响比赛的方式。互相竞争并帮助对方的长处和短处是可行的。 ‘我们做了很多不同的事情。最终，它是关于得分、创建和链接游戏。我们以自己不同的方式做到这一点。 “即使这可能是一款更适合其中一种游戏的游戏，但我们仍然可以发挥我们的影响力。”这是关于与球队其他成员互相帮助，互相学习，并努力让切尔西尽可能成为最好的版本。”这种态度也是罗杰斯思考自己角色的核心。我们看到他在阿斯顿维拉的不同位置上都表现出色：十号位、八号位和边路。无论阿隆索选择将他部署在切尔西蓝色的何处，罗杰斯都会专注于最大化他的输出以实现更大的利益。 “我可以胜任多个位置，这可能是我的强项，”这位 24 岁的球员说道。 “我可以适应并为经理们提供对不同职位不同的看法。我一直都是这样长大的。像我一样理解比赛、学习比赛、享受比赛、热爱比赛，我从来不想陷入一种位置或一种属性。多才多艺对我很有帮助。罗杰斯补充道：“这是一场团队比赛，场上有 11 名球员，无论我被赋予什么角色，无论主教练和其他球员对我有什么要求，我都会尽力而为。”我不是一个陷入必须得分或助攻的球员。 “只要我能贡献、创造、提供或做任何必要的事情来得分和获胜，这就是我所关心的。”作为今年夏天迄今为止最引人注目的转会之一，罗杰斯从西米德兰兹转会到西伦敦不可避免地会带来额外的期望，尤其是来自外部观察家的期望。不过，罗杰斯对这一前景很平静，并准备好迎接挑战。 “压力带来兴奋，”他说。 “我认为如果你不为任何事情而打球，那么那种兴奋、那种嗡嗡声、那种感觉就不存在了。带着这种压力和感觉打球只会有帮助。 ‘我很期待。我很兴奋。我让其他人在场外谈论类似的事情。 “我只是要展示我在球场上能做什么，为什么我在这里，为什么我应该在这里，以及我如何影响和帮助球队并影响比赛。这就是我来这里的全部目的。”我们很快就能看到罗杰斯将这一观点付诸实践。

news.title: Introducing Cobham Next Gen
news.title_zh: 科巴姆下一代简介
news.body_en: From the start of the 2026/27 season, Chelsea's Under-21s and Under-19s squads will be known as Cobham Next Gen (CNG) under head coach Harry Hudson. The new name more accurately reflects the age profile of our leading Academy side and Chelsea's long-standing heritage of developing the next generation of players for the senior game. While the squad competed in Premier League 2 as an Under-21s side, its average age last season was closer to that of an Under-18s group, with several players as young as 16 years old featuring regularly. Cobham Next Gen also better fits the role of the squad within the Academy. It recognises a group of young players with momentum, taking the next step in their development - the final one in the pathway to senior football - competing at a higher level as they continue their journey through Cobham towards the men's team. Chelsea's Academy has a proud history of producing players for the men's team. Club captain Reece James, Levi Colwill and Josh Acheampong are among the Academy graduates in our current senior squad. Many more have gone on to enjoy successful careers throughout English football and across Europe's leading leagues, reflecting the quality of the Chelsea development programme and our commitment to transitioning players made in Cobham into first team football. Providing young players with opportunities to compete above their natural age group remains a key part of the club's approach to player development. That was reflected last season as one of the youngest squads in the Premier League 2 finished at the top of the table. The introduction of Cobham Next Gen also strengthens the Academy's identity. More than an age-group name, it represents the players progressing through Cobham and the opportunities available to them as they continue their development towards the men's game. This new identity reflects the distinction of Chelsea’s Academy as a unique footballing environment with its own history, culture and proven record of developing players for the highest level of the game. You can watch Cobham Next Gen fixtures – and those of our Under-18s – throughout the season on the Official Chelsea App and website via a CFC+ subscription.

news.title: Pre-Season Briefing 2026/27 part two: Fighting on three fronts
news.title_zh: 2026/27赛季前简报第二部分：三线作战
news.body_en: In the second part of our look ahead to 2026/27, club historian Rick Glanvill and club statistician Paul Dutton focus on the competitions Xabi Alonso’s Chelsea will be participating in this season… We enter the 35th edition of the Premier League with Chelsea one of six ever-present members. Fixtures are subject to change but as was the case in 2025/26, 33 rounds of matches will be played over weekends and five in midweek. For only the third time in three decades, the Blues are not involved in any European campaign this season. Xabi Alonso’s side will play six league games before leaving the capital. Fulham are Chelsea’s opening-day hosts in what will be the Blues’ first Monday start since a 3-1 victory at Brighton in September 2020. In fact, the Seagulls are the first visitors to the Bridge. There follows a trip to Arsenal, a home game against Hull, another London away day – this time at Brentford – before Bournemouth come to SW6. Of course, there will be fewer London derbies overall after the relegation of West Ham, along with Burnley and Wolverhampton. Three familiar faces have reclaimed top-flight status in their place. It is 25 years since Coventry rubbed shoulders with the elite and nine for Hull, while Ipswich spent just one season on the second rung. In 2024/25, Chelsea claimed one point from a possible six against the Tractor Boys. Our last league meeting with the Sky Blues at Highfield Road ended 0-0, but at Stamford Bridge it was a one-sided affair, Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink netting four in a 6-1 thrashing. Blues legend Frank Lampard brings his Sky Blues to the Fulham Road in March. The Tigers were the first ever competitive visitors to the Bridge in 1905 and were mauled 5-1. In 2016/17, both league fixtures ended in 2-0 Chelsea wins. The Blues’ most recent title triumph was that season. Alonso will want to improve on last term’s unusually poor tally of just five points taken from a possible 18 against newly-elevated teams. Alonso will be hoping to follow in the footsteps of 11 Chelsea managers have won trophies within a year of taking charge of the club: Ruud Gullit, Gianluca Vialli, Jose Mourinho, Carlo Ancelotti, Guus Hiddink, Rafael Benitez, Roberto Di Matteo, Antonio Conte, Maurizio Sarri, Thomas Tuchel and Enzo Maresca. Last season Chelsea were runners-up to Manchester City in a competition we have won eight times, most recently in 2017/18. As usual, we will join the competition in round three, which will be played over the weekend of 9/10 January 2027. The draw for third round fixtures will take place after round two matches played over the weekend of 5/6 December 2026. Wembley will host the final on Saturday 22 May 2026 and the winners qualify for the Europa League. Live coverage is shared by the BBC and TNT Sports/HBO Max. With nine Premier League contestants involved in Europe, this competition again featured a preliminary qualifying round. Chelsea’s 66th League Cup campaign will begin earlier than usual in round two, with the Blues paired with League One side Luton Town. That game at the Bridge is on Thursday 27 August. To accommodate clubs’ European commitments, third round fixtures will again be split over two weeks: 8/9 and 15/16 September. The final will be at Wembley on Sunday 21 March 2026 and the winners gain entrance to the play-off round of the UEFA Conference League. - in the third instalment of our Pre-Season Briefing tomorrow (Wednesday), we will bring you the updated rules and regulations for 2026/27...
news.body_zh: 在我们展望 2026/27 赛季的第二部分中，俱乐部历史学家里克·格兰维尔和俱乐部统计学家保罗·达顿重点关注了哈维·阿隆索的切尔西将参加本赛季的比赛……我们进入了第 35 届英超联赛，切尔西是六名常驻成员之一。赛程可能会发生变化，但与 2025/26 赛季一样，33 轮比赛将在周末进行，5 轮比赛将在周中进行。这是蓝军三十年来第三次没有参加本赛季的任何欧洲赛事。哈维·阿隆索的球队在离开首都之前将踢六场联赛。富勒姆是切尔西揭幕战的东道主，这将是蓝军自 2020 年 9 月 3-1 战胜布莱顿以来首次在周一首发。事实上，海鸥队是第一批造访这座桥的客队。接下来是前往阿森纳、主场对阵赫尔城的比赛，以及另一场伦敦客场比赛——这次是在布伦特福德——然后伯恩茅斯来到了西南六区。当然，西汉姆联降级后，伦敦德比总体上会减少，伯恩利和狼队也一样。三位熟悉的面孔取代了他们的位置，重新获得了顶级联赛的地位。考文垂和赫尔城已经有 25 年的历史，而赫尔城则有 9 年的历史，而伊普斯维奇只在第二梯队度过了一个赛季。 2024/25赛季，切尔西在对阵拖拉机男孩的比赛中获得了可能的六分中的一分。我们上次在海菲尔德路与天蓝队的联赛比赛以 0-0 结束，但在斯坦福桥却是一场一边倒的比赛，吉米·弗洛伊德·哈塞尔巴因克 (Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink) 在一场 6-1 的惨败中攻入四球。蓝军传奇人物弗兰克·兰帕德将于三月将他的天蓝队带到富勒姆路。 1905 年，老虎队成为第一支造访这座桥的竞技客队，但被 5-1 惨败。 2016/17赛季，两场联赛均以切尔西2-0获胜告终。蓝军最近一次夺冠是在那个赛季。阿隆索希望能够改善上赛季异常糟糕的得分情况，在对阵新升级球队的 18 场比赛中仅得到 5 分。阿隆索希望追随11位切尔西主教练的脚步，他们在执掌俱乐部一年内赢得了奖杯：路德·古利特、吉安卢卡·维亚利、何塞·穆里尼奥、卡洛·安切洛蒂、古斯·希丁克、拉斐尔·贝尼特斯、罗伯托·迪马特奥、安东尼奥·孔蒂、毛里齐奥·萨里、托马斯·图赫尔和恩佐·马雷斯卡。上赛季，切尔西在这项赛事中输给曼城获得亚军，我们已经八次获胜，最近一次是在 2017/18 赛季。像往常一样，我们将参加第三轮的比赛，该比赛将于 2027 年 1 月 9 日至 10 日的周末进行。第三轮比赛的抽签将在 2026 年 12 月 5 日至 6 日的周末进行第二轮比赛后进行。温布利将于 2026 年 5 月 22 日星期六举办决赛，获胜者将有资格参加欧洲联赛。 BBC 和 TNT Sports/HBO Max 共享现场报道。本次比赛有九名英超参赛者参加欧洲比赛，再次进行预选赛。切尔西的第 66 届联赛杯第二轮比赛将比平常提前开始，蓝军将对阵英甲球队卢顿镇。这场比赛将于 8 月 27 日星期四在桥举行。为了适应俱乐部的欧洲承诺，第三轮比赛将再次分为两周进行：9月8日和9月15日和2016年15日。决赛将于 2026 年 3 月 21 日星期日在温布利举行，获胜者将进入欧洲足联会议联赛附加赛。 - 在明天（周三）的季前简报的第三部分中，我们将为您带来 2026/27 赛季的最新规则和条例...

news.body_en: Ticket selling details have been announced for our first cup tie of the season. Chelsea take on Luton Town in the second round of the Carabao Cup on Thursday 27 August with a 7.30pm kick-off at Stamford Bridge. Ticket sales for this match will be as follows: Luton have taken an increased allocation in the Shed End for this fixture meaning we have to displace all season ticket holders in the Shed upper and Shed lower tiers. Therefore, displaced season ticket holders can purchase any of the available seats not taken by a season ticket holder during the reservation period. There will be a specific on-sale period providing displaced season ticket holders with the priority opportunity to purchase elsewhere in the stadium. From Tuesday 18 August 10am until Thursday 20 August 9am: Season tickets holders can purchase their own seat (Including those enrolled on the cup scheme). You will find your reservation under the ‘reserved tickets’ once you have logged into your account via the ticketing portal. Thursday 20 August 10am until 2pm: Displaced supporters in the Shed lower and Shed upper tiers have priority to buy another available seat in other areas of the stadium. Thursday 20 August 3pm until Friday 21 August 9am: Season ticket holders who have not purchased a seat will be able to purchase any remaining seat that has not been taken by a fellow season ticket holder in the reservation period. Home tickets for members for men’s team matches are now allocated through a new application process. For each home match, eligible members have a designated application window during which they can apply for tickets. Applications can be made individually or as a group, provided all members of the group are eligible to apply during that window. Tickets are allocated one per person with a maximum of four per application. Ticket application window opens – Tuesday 18 August 12pm Ticket application window closes – Thursday 20 August 12pm The ticket application window will be open for True Blue+, True Blue, CFC Blue and Junior Blue members. As part of the verification process, a pre-authorisation charge £0.01 will be applied to validate your payment card. No money will be taken at this stage, and the hold will be removed by your provider. Tickets for this match are priced at Category G. Please click here for match ticket prices Tickets will appear on the Chelsea Official App prior to the event. Eligible members can submit their application at any time during the window. Applying earlier does not increase the likelihood of success, giving supporters greater flexibility to apply at a time that suits them. As part of the new ticket sales process, members who are eligible for concession-rate tickets are automatically assigned their price class. To ensure you are receiving the correct ticket, please take the time to check the date of birth on your account is accurate. You will only be allocated tickets in your selected areas unless you choose to be considered for other available options. If you only wish to be entered for tickets in one area of the stadium, please leave the second option blank. Please read the ticket application information carefully before submitting your application. Successful and unsuccessful applications will be notified by email within four working days of the ticket application window closing date. Successful applications will be charged to their payment card approximately at this time. Supporters are not able to use account credit for ticket application window purchases. Tickets are for Chelsea supporters only. All persons under the age of 16 will be required to attend with and sit next to, a person aged 18 years of age or over. Members and season ticket holders can purchase Westview tickets for Carabao Cup home games via the Chelsea FC Official Ticketing Portal. A maximum of four tickets can be bought per person, and only the ticket purchaser is required to be a member or season ticket holder. You are not required to be a member or season ticket holder to purchase non-Westview Club Chelsea packages. Club Chelsea tickets are non-refundable unless the match is cancelled, postponed or moved more than 48 hours either side of the scheduled fixture date. All Club Chelsea ticket purchases are subject to Club Chelsea terms and conditions. For any further Westview enquiries, please email clubchelsea@chelseafc.com. Loyalty points will now only be awarded for attendance at men’s first-team home matches and no longer accrued for purchasing tickets. Points will be added to eligible accounts following each game, provided the ticket has been scanned at the turnstile. This means that supporters purchasing tickets on the ticket exchange, or receiving tickets via ticket forwarding, will now receive loyalty points for attending matches. Please note those with Ticket Forwarding Memberships will not accrue loyalty points for attendance. Supporters will receive five loyalty points for attending this match. Points will be applied after the fixture has been played. Supporters who require accessible tickets can apply through the accessible ticket application window. Timings are below: Accessible ticket application window opens – Tuesday 18 August 12pm Accessible ticket application window closes – Thursday 20 August 12pm Supporters, if they are able to do so, can call our Access Team on 0371 811 2012 or 0044 207 915 1950 (international callers) for any questions or if they need further information. Personal assistant tickets can be submitted during this ticket application window. Supporters who are looking to gain access to a lift when attending a fixture, please email access@chelseafc.com Supporters can apply for car parking by clicking here from Friday 21 August. You are required to display your Blue Badge while parked at Stamford Bridge. There will be no ticket exchange in operation for this fixture. Once open, season ticket holders and members can send and receive tickets up until three hours before kick-off. Please note that those who have forwarded their ticket will not be able to list their ticket on the ticket exchange. Click for ticket forwarding FAQs Refunds will only be made in accordance with the Conditions of Issue. Requests to refund tickets purchased from the general admission on-sale period must be submitted via the form below. Match and ticket application window dates are subject to change. All ticket sales are subject to availability. Please check the website for the latest information.

news.title: Jashayde Greenwood pens first professional contract
news.title_zh: 贾沙伊德·格林伍德签署第一份职业合同
news.body_en: Chelsea Football Club is pleased to announce that Academy striker Jashayde Greenwood has signed his first professional contract with the club following his 17th birthday. The forward joined Chelsea ahead of the 2025/26 campaign, arriving from Wolverhampton Wanderers to link up with our Under-18s squad. Greenwood had already gained Under-18 Premier League experience during the 2024/25 season, making seven appearances and scoring once for Wolves while still a schoolboy. He made an immediate impact after joining the Blues, helping Dan Hogan's Under-18s side lift both the southern and national titles in Under-18 Premier League. Across all competitions, Greenwood made 23 appearances and scored nine goals during the campaign. On the international stage, Greenwood has represented England at Under-16 level.
news.body_zh: 切尔西足球俱乐部很高兴地宣布青训前锋贾沙伊德·格林伍德在 17 岁生日后与俱乐部签订了第一份职业合同。这位前锋在 2025/26 赛季之前从伍尔弗汉普顿流浪者队加盟切尔西，与我们的 18 岁以下青年队会合。格林伍德在 2024/25 赛季已经获得了 18 岁以下英超联赛的经验，在还是一名学生时就为狼队出场 7 次并进球一次。加盟蓝军后，他立即产生了影响，帮助丹·霍根 (Dan Hogan) 的 18 岁以下球队在 18 岁以下英超联赛中夺得南部和全国冠军。整个赛季，格林伍德在各项赛事中出场 23 次，打进 9 球。在国际舞台上，格林伍德曾代表英格兰参加U-16级别比赛。

news.title: Bompastor outlines Chelsea Women’s ambitions this season
news.title_zh: 邦帕斯特概述了切尔西女足本赛季的雄心
news.body_en: With Chelsea Women’s exciting pre-season tour of New Zealand and Australia over and the focus turning to the start of our competitive campaign, Sonia Bompastor has summarised what the Blues want to achieve in 2026/27. The players have returned to work at Cobham after a productive period spent on the other side of the world, which included impressive friendly victories against Auckland and an A-League All-Stars side. Now the start of the season is in sight. First up, we meet Real Sociedad in the UEFA Women's Champions League third qualifying round, with the Spanish side coming to London for the first leg next Wednesday 26 August – a game for which tickets are on now on sale. As she prepares for her third season in charge of Chelsea, Bompastor is under no illusion as to the standards expected at the club. She is determined to return the Blues to the very top of the domestic game. ‘Obviously the ambition at Chelsea is to win everything,’ said Bompastor. ‘We know that. That's why we work so hard every day. We have set our goals. We want to go as far as possible in every competition, but we also know the competition is becoming more difficult because a lot of clubs are investing, and a lot of clubs now are able to perform at their best. So, we are also realistic. 'I said last season we are facing a transition, and I think we are rebuilding in terms of refreshing the squad, rebuilding the culture within the team, and we'll try our best. We'll work as hard as possible to try to win trophies. ‘There are fine margins, and sometimes as much as you work hard, things don't always go the way you want. It's up to us to make sure we turn things our way.’
news.body_zh: 随着切尔西女足激动人心的新西兰和澳大利亚季前赛之旅结束，焦点转向我们竞争性赛季的开始，索尼娅·邦帕斯特总结了蓝军希望在 2026/27 年实现的目标。球员们在世界的另一边度过了一段富有成效的时期，其中包括对阵奥克兰队和澳超全明星队的令人印象深刻的友谊赛胜利，之后他们回到了科巴姆工作。现在赛季即将开始。首先，我们将在欧洲女子冠军联赛第三轮预选赛中迎战皇家社会队，这支西班牙球队将在下周三（8 月 26 日）前往伦敦进行首回合比赛，这场比赛的门票现已开始发售。当邦帕斯特为执掌切尔西的第三个赛季做准备时，她对俱乐部的预期标准并不抱有任何幻想。她决心让蓝军重返国内赛场的巅峰。 “显然，切尔西的野心是赢得一切，”邦帕斯特说道。 '我们知道这一点。这就是我们每天如此努力工作的原因。我们已经设定了目标。我们希望在每场比赛中都走得尽可能远，但我们也知道比赛变得越来越困难，因为很多俱乐部都在投资，现在很多俱乐部都能够发挥出最好的水平。所以，我们也是现实的。 “我上赛季说过我们正面临转型，我认为我们正在重建球队，重建队内文化，我们会尽力而为。我们将尽最大努力争取赢得奖杯。 “利润微薄，有时尽管你努力工作，事情并不总是如你所愿。我们有责任确保事情朝着我们自己的方向发展。”

news.title: Club Chelsea welcomes new hospitality spaces ahead of 2026/27 season at Stamford Bridge
news.title_zh: 切尔西俱乐部在 2026/27 赛季到来之前在斯坦福桥迎来新的接待空间
news.body_en: Our home stadium commences the season with multiple new and enhanced spaces across our Club Chelsea portfolio. The updates are part of the club’s ongoing commitment to investing in and delivering market-leading, innovative experiences, setting new benchmarks in premium hospitality and fan engagement. Designed in response to evolving industry trends and growing demand for experience-led hospitality, each space offers a distinct atmosphere, capacity and hospitality proposition, creating new opportunities for networking, socialising and premium entertainment while delivering market-leading VIP experiences that reflect Club Chelsea’s brand positioning. The new and updated spaces for the 2026/27 season include: The newly reimagined Harris Suite will combine state-of-the-art facilities with an immersive dining concept. The highly sought-after lounge is already sold out on a seasonal basis, with limited match-by-match availability remaining. The Clubhouse is a new ultra-premium hospitality concept in Stamford Bridge’s West Stand. Five private boxes have been brought together to create one exclusive space, offering members a slick setting to enjoy matchday. Located within our former broadcast suite, The Corner Club is an intimate 20-seat private box positioned directly above the corner flag. Reimagined from the ground up, the space takes inspiration from the world of speakeasies to create a distinctive environment, offering guests an exclusive vantage point from which to experience the action. Stamford Bridge’s Captains’ & Managers ‘Bars have been redeveloped to offer members a relaxed and informal hospitality experience. The spaces provide the perfect setting to enjoy pre- and post-match refreshments. The Green Room is located within Stamford Bridge’s onsite music venue, Under The Bridge, in a space previously reserved for artists and performers ahead of live shows. The intimate 10-seat setting blends exclusivity with the unique character of one of London’s renowned live music venues. Bonnie Rolfe, venue director for Chelsea Football Club, said: ‘These new spaces at Stamford Bridge reflect our commitment to continually evolving the hospitality experience at Chelsea Football Club. By creating a range of premium environments for different audiences, we are ensuring guests can enjoy a matchday experience that feels distinctive, memorable and true to Club Chelsea.’ Enquiries for limited seasonal memberships are open and Premier League matchday packages are on-sale. - Click to get in touch with the Club Chelsea team to find out more Images have been produced by AI and are illustrative only

news.title: FPL 2026/27: Chelsea players under £6m
news.title_zh: FPL 2026/27：切尔西球员低于 600 万英镑
news.body_en: There is less than a week left to select your Fantasy Premier League team for the start of the season and we have picked out some of the Chelsea players outside the highest prices who would provide excellent value for money in any fantasy squad. We have teamed up with Fantasy Football Scout to provide supporters with some Blues-themed tips and advice for the Fantasy Premier League, particularly useful at this time of year as fans around the world finalise their selections for the coming season, which begins this weekend. With expensive assets like Joao Pedro (£7.5m), Cole Palmer (£9.5m) and Morgan Rogers (£7.5m) already at the forefront of FPL managers' minds, it is important not to forget about the more affordable assets, who might not be as obvious point earners but provide excellent value for money. Making the right decisions about the best £6m-and-under players can be the difference when it comes to getting off to a great start to the FPL season and competing at the top of your Mini-Leagues right from the first match week. New Chelsea signing Maxence Lacroix (£6m) could be a fantastic option for FPL managers. The Frenchman was the eighth-highest-scoring defender in the Fantasy Premier League last season with 154 points. He was also the third-best defender in the league for defensive contribution points, registering 40. Fellow summer signing Marco Palestra (£5.5m) is £0.5m cheaper than Lacroix and has the additional FPL appeal of being able to play on both sides of the pitch. He was the second-fastest player in Serie A and could bring plenty of FPL points under manager Xabi Alonso, who has played with attacking full-backs or wing-backs in the past. news.title: Pre-Season Briefing 2026/27 part one: How Alonso’s Chelsea is taking shape
news.title_zh: 2026/27 季前简报第一部分：阿隆索的切尔西如何成形
news.body_en: In the week the Premier League gets underway, Chelsea’s official historian Rick Glanvill analyses pre-season to see how the Blues could look under new manager Xabi Alonso and with several new recruits in our ranks. Chelsea have fielded the youngest starting XI in the past three Premier League seasons. But new manager Xabi Alonso has set about building the same blend of youth and experience at Stamford Bridge that earned an unprecedented league and cup double for Bayer Leverkusen three seasons ago in Germany. The approach also incudes an emphasis on mentality, to match the metrics and motivation, plus height, pace and physicality to handle Europe’s toughest title chase. The Basque coach’s pre-season training has been intense and friendly matches have suggested the principles of play he is instilling. The team have shown progressive passing, front-to-back attacking, width from wingers and full-backs and less dependency on possession for its own sake. Those who missed out on FIFA’s international jamboree at the World Cup – such as Estevao Willian, Levi Colwill, Cole Palmer and Joao Pedro (prolific in pre-season) – are looking promisingly sharp. Plenty of the Cobham cohort have caught Alonso’s eye, while new arrivals like 18-year-old Kazakh national hero Dastan Satpayev (now on loan at Burnley) justified their switch with impressive cameos. Morgan Rogers reunited with Manchester City academy team-mate Cole Palmer offers the prospect of a team with two scheming No10s. The high-profile signing from Aston Villa will have savoured scoring on his friendly debut against Real Sociedad. Little needs saying about centre-forward Danny Welbeck or midfield general Jordan Henderson except that their vast Premier League experience is matched only by the high regard shown for them by their footballing peers. France international Maxence Lacroix has crossed London from Crystal Palace with exceptional metrics for a centre-back. Marco Palestra arrives from Serie A having clocked the fastest average speed last season, with multiple take-ons in the red-and-blue of Cagliari. Fellow full-back Pep Chavarria is a tenacious speedster with a TikTok-perfect portfolio of stunning goals from distance for Rayo Vallecano. Mike Penders‘ great height and concentration invite comparisons with Chelsea’s most recent title-winning goalkeeper and fellow Belgian Thibaut Courtois. Meanwhile, Austin MacPhee, one of the most successful set-play masterminds over recent seasons, has switched over from the Villa Park dugout to Stamford Bridge. Last season, the scheming Scot’s plotting led to 29 goals from set-pieces for Villa, the joint-most in the top flight, with Rogers handed a key role. In 2025/26, Chelsea scored the fifth-most goals and had the sixth-highest goal difference, but there is room for improvement on game management, discipline and responding to adversity. Disappointingly, Chelsea let 17 points slip from winning positions at home – the most of any team in the division. Red cards contributed towards the Blues losing 19 points from a possible 24 in the league – including in the equivalent to our opening fixture at Fulham. Alonso and his staff will set out to rewire those negatives to positives. - We will be bringing you more insight ahead of the new season throughout the week, including a look at the competitions we will be involved in, new regulations for the season and upcoming milestones...
news.body_zh: 在英超联赛开始的那一周，切尔西的官方历史学家里克·格兰维尔分析了季前赛，看看蓝军在新教练哈维·阿隆索和几名新球员的带领下会是什么样子。切尔西在过去三个英超赛季中派出了最年轻的首发阵容。但新任主教练哈维·阿隆索已经着手在斯坦福桥建立同样的年轻和经验融合，三个赛季前在德国为勒沃库森赢得了前所未有的联赛和杯赛双冠王。这种方法还包括强调心态，以匹配指标和动机，加上身高、速度和身体素质，以应对欧洲最艰难的冠军争夺战。这位巴斯克教练的季前训练非常紧张，友谊赛也体现​​了他正在灌输的比赛原则。球队展示了渐进式传球、前后进攻、边锋和边后卫的宽度以及更少的控球依赖。那些错过了国际足联世界杯国际盛会的人——比如埃斯特沃·威廉、利维·科尔威尔、科尔·帕尔默和若昂·佩德罗（在季前赛中表现出色）——看起来都非常敏锐。科巴姆的很多球员都引起了阿隆索的注意，而像 18 岁的哈萨克斯坦民族英雄达斯坦·萨特帕耶夫（现租借至伯恩利）这样的新援也以令人印象深刻的客串证明了他们的转变是合理的。摩根·罗杰斯与曼城青训队友科尔·帕尔默重聚，为一支拥有两名诡计多端的十号球员的球队提供了前景。这位来自阿斯顿维拉的高调签约将在对阵皇家社会的友谊赛首秀中收获进球。中锋丹尼·维尔贝克或中场大将乔丹·亨德森几乎不需要多说，除了他们丰富的英超经验与足球同行对他们的高度评价相匹配之外。法国国脚马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦以中后卫的出色表现从水晶宫穿越伦敦。来自意甲的马科·帕莱斯特拉上赛季在卡利亚里的红蓝军团中多次抢断，取得了最快的平均速度。后卫佩普·查瓦里亚 (Pep Chavarria) 是一名顽强的速度型球员，为拉约·巴列卡诺 (Rayo Vallecano) 带来了一系列令人惊叹的远距离进球。迈克·彭德斯的身高和注意力很容易让人与切尔西最近夺冠的门将、比利时同胞蒂博·库尔图瓦进行比较。与此同时，近几个赛季最成功的定位球策划者之一奥斯汀·麦克菲(Austin MacPhee)已经从维拉公园的教练席转到了斯坦福桥。上赛季，这位诡计多端的苏格兰人的阴谋为维拉打进了 29 粒定位球，成为顶级联赛中进球数最多的球队，而罗杰斯则扮演了关键角色。 2025/26赛季，切尔西进球数排名第五，净胜球排名第六，但在比赛管理、纪律和应对逆境方面还有改进的空间。令人失望的是，切尔西在主场从胜利的位置上丢掉了 17 分——是分区内最多的球队。红牌导致蓝军在联赛中丢掉了 24 分中的 19 分，其中包括我们对阵富勒姆的首场比赛。阿隆索和他的团队将着手将这些负面因素重新转化为积极因素。 - 我们将在整个星期为您带来新赛季前的更多见解，包括我们将参加的比赛、本赛季的新规则以及即将到来的里程碑……

news.title: Joao Pedro on trusting his instinct and ambitions for the season ahead
news.title_zh: 若昂·佩德罗相信自己的直觉和对未来赛季的抱负
news.body_en: Only a small group of people know the other Joao Pedro. He is reserved for a special few in Brazil, those who were by his side long before his time in England and with Chelsea. This Joao Pedro is not the determined and talented forward who, within his first year at Stamford Bridge, was crowned world champion, scored 20 goals in the 2025/26 campaign, and was voted by Blues supporters as their Player of the Season. He is just a young man who enjoys being back home in Brazil with people he cares about. ‘When I go to Brazil and stay with my friends, I try not to think too much about football,’ the 24-year-old says after sitting down with us at the team hotel during our pre-season tour of Australia and Asia. ‘I don’t play football with them or anything like this; I just try to relax and enjoy myself with them. ‘Brazil is my country; it’s where I grew up. So, whenever I have a holiday, it always feels good to be back there with my friends and family. It helps me recover and enjoy my break and means I can come back 100 per cent.’ Admittedly, Joao Pedro didn’t want the summer off; he would have much rather represented Brazil at the World Cup in North America. Yet time away – which also included a holiday in Cyprus – has allowed Joao Pedro to return to Chelsea fresh and sharp. That has been evident throughout pre-season, with our No.20 scoring seven goals in just five matches. Yet he believes there is more to come, and the Brazil international wants individual achievements to align with collective success in the season ahead. ‘My first year here was special, but it wasn’t what we wanted as a group. So, I will continue to give my best and hopefully I can have another good season and the team also achieves our targets. ‘I know that when a new player joins a club, sometimes it can be a little bit difficult. For me at Chelsea, it was completely different. I felt at home straight away and won a trophy after just ten days! ‘I feel very comfortable here and, hopefully, we can win more titles together.’ On Joao Pedro’s return to Chelsea for pre-season training, there was a new voice to listen to on and off the pitch, with Xabi Alonso now leading the first team. The Blues forward has enjoyed working with the Spaniard thus far, emphasising that Alonso has quickly developed a positive and open environment at Cobham and beyond. He said: ‘The manager is very open; he has come here to help everyone. I’ve had a few chats with him, which I have enjoyed a lot. I’m looking forward a lot to the season to try to help him and Chelsea achieve the targets.’ Throughout his first season at Chelsea, what stood out was Joao Pedro’s understanding of different roles within the side and his adaptability on the pitch. It meant he scored a variety of goals, from the long-range piledriver at Napoli to the close-range header at home against West Ham United. And let’s not overlook his spectacular overhead kick against Nottingham Forest, which was named Goal of the Season by supporters. ‘My position has always been number nine,’ says Joao Pedro. ‘But because I have good technique, I can come deeper or go to the wing. But I just want to play and help the team on the pitch. ‘Sometimes I will be deep, sometimes in the box. What I can’t lose is the instinct of where I need to be on the pitch. Sometimes, in football, you just need to feel. ‘If you just stay in the box, maybe you don’t get many chances. But if you stay outside, you can be far away from the goal. So, I need to use this feeling and then score goals. ‘When I was younger, I played in different positions; I think it has helped me a lot. But we have top players in the middle of the pitch, so I will focus on scoring the goals!’ It's an approach that has certainly worked throughout Joao Pedro's time at Stamford Bridge – and Blues supporters will hope it leads to more success in the season ahead.
news.body_zh: 只有一小部分人认识另一个若昂·佩德罗。他在巴西是为少数特殊的人保留的，那些早在他进入英格兰和切尔西之前就在他身边的人。这位若昂·佩德罗并不是一位意志坚定、才华横溢的前锋，他在斯坦福桥的第一年就加冕了世界冠军，在2025/26赛季攻入20个进球，并被蓝军球迷票选为赛季最佳球员。他只是一个年轻人，喜欢回到巴西的家乡和他关心的人在一起。 “当我去巴西和朋友们待在一起时，我尽量不去想太多关于足球的事情，”这位 24 岁的球员在我们的澳大利亚和亚洲季前之旅期间在球队酒店与我们坐下后说道。 “我不和他们一起踢足球或者类似的事情；我只是试着放松并和他们一起享受。 “巴西是我的国家；这是我长大的地方。因此，每当我放假时，与朋友和家人一起回到那里总是感觉很好。它可以帮助我恢复并享受休息时间，也意味着我可以百分百恢复状态。”不可否认，若昂·佩德罗并不想放暑假；他不想让自己在夏天休息。他更愿意代表巴西参加北美世界杯。然而，离开一段时间——其中还包括在塞浦路斯度假——让若昂·佩德罗以新鲜和锐利的方式回到切尔西。这在整个季前赛中都很明显，我们的 20 号球员在短短 5 场比赛中就打进了 7 个进球。然而他相信未来还会有更多，这位巴西国脚希望个人成就与未来赛季的集体成功保持一致。 “我在这里的第一年很特别，但这并不是我们作为一个团队想要的。所以，我会继续全力以赴，希望我能再打一个好赛季，球队也能实现我们的目标。 “我知道当一名新球员加入俱乐部时，有时会有点困难。对我在切尔西来说，情况完全不同。我立即感到宾至如归，并在短短十天后就赢得了奖杯！ “我在这里感觉很舒服，希望我们能一起赢得更多冠军。”若昂·佩德罗回到切尔西进行季前训练时，球场内外都有新的声音可供聆听，哈维·阿隆索现在领导着一线队。到目前为止，这位蓝军前锋很享受与西班牙人的合作，他强调阿隆索很快在科巴姆及其他地方建立了一个积极和开放的环境。他说：“主教练非常开放；他来这里是为了帮助大家。我和他聊过几次，我很享受。我非常期待这个赛季能够帮助他和切尔西实现目标。”在切尔西的第一个赛季中，若昂·佩德罗最突出的是他对球队内不同角色的理解以及他在球场上的适应能力。这意味着他打进了各种各样的进球，从那不勒斯的远射打桩机到主场对阵西汉姆联的近距离头球。我们也不要忽视他在对阵诺丁汉森林队的比赛中精彩的倒钩球，该进球被球迷们评为本赛季最佳进球。 “我的位置一直是第九，”若昂·佩德罗说。 “但是因为我有很好的技术，所以我可以走得更深或者去边路。但我只想在球场上踢球并帮助球队。 “有时我会深入防守，有时会在禁区里。我不能失去的是我需要在球场上的本能。有时候，在足球场上，你只需要感觉。 “如果你只是呆在禁区里，也许你不会得到很多机会。但如果你留在外面，你可能离目标很远。所以，我需要利用这种感觉，然后进球。 “当我年轻的时候，我踢过不同的位置；我认为这对我有很大帮助。但我们在球场中间有顶级球员，所以我会专注于进球！”这种方法在若昂·佩德罗在斯坦福桥的整个时期都发挥了作用，蓝军的支持者希望它在未来的赛季取得更大的成功。

news.title: James feeling good and can’t wait for the season to start
news.title_zh: 詹姆斯感觉很好，迫不及待地等待赛季开始
news.body_en: Reece James believes Chelsea’s friendly win over Real Sociedad showed he and the team’s preparations for the new season are on course and our skipper can’t wait for it to begin. The Blues’ final fixture of pre-season brought us back to Stamford Bridge after our tour of Asia and Australia, as the last members of Xabi Alonso’s squad – including James – returned to action following their post-World Cup break. With a week to go until the campaign kicks off, it was a promising performance from the Blues, as Morgan Rogers marked his first appearance for the club with the opening goal and Joao Pedro netted twice to give us a 3-1 win over Real Sociedad. Our captain featured for the first hour of that victory and was pleased with another step forward in pre-season for him and his team-mates. ‘It was a good performance from the team,’ said James. ‘I’m happy to be back out there and the season starts this time in a week. ‘The break’s been pretty short so I felt pretty good out there yesterday. The conditions were tough, it was super hot, but I’m feeling good. ‘It’s still early, there was a bit of rust still to come off, but yesterday was a good step. ‘It was a short break, probably shorter than everyone would have liked, but I’m delighted to be back and the new season’s going to be getting under way pretty soon.’ James and the rest of the Blues who were involved in the latter stages of the World Cup with their countries over the summer returned to training at Cobham last week, with Alonso speaking publicly about the importance of having our captain back in the squad. ‘It means a lot coming from a manager and an ex-player of his calibre,’ Reece responded. ‘It means a lot so hopefully I can give my all for him and deliver when I’m needed most. ‘They’ve just come off the pre-season tour which was a lot of travelling, a lot of games, but from what I’ve seen everyone’s settled in well and I’m delighted with the group. ‘It’s only been four or five days, it’s been super short, but I’m enjoying it very much so far and that’s the same for the boys.’ With the pre-season games now completed, the next time James and Chelsea take to the pitch will be in competitive action, with one week to go until the Premier League begins. For the Blues, that means taking the short trip up the road to face neighbours Fulham at Craven Cottage on the evening of Monday 24 August. ‘It’s a super difficult London derby to start off our Premier League campaign but we’re excited and the preparation for that will start pretty soon. I can’t wait!’
news.body_zh: 里斯·詹姆斯相信切尔西对皇家社会的友谊赛表明他和球队为新赛季的准备工作正在按部就班，我们的队长已经迫不及待地等待它的开始。在亚洲和澳大利亚之旅结束后，蓝军季前赛的最后一场比赛将我们带回斯坦福桥，哈维·阿隆索队的最后一批成员——包括詹姆斯——在世界杯结束后重返赛场。距离赛季开始还有一周时间，蓝军的表现令人期待，摩根·罗杰斯首次为俱乐部出场就打入首球，若奥·佩德罗梅开二度帮助我们以 3-1 战胜皇家社会。我们的队长在这场胜利的第一个小时中表现出色，并对他和他的队友在季前赛中又向前迈出了一步感到高兴。 “球队的表现很好，”詹姆斯说。 “我很高兴回到那里，赛季在一周后的这个时候开始。 “休息时间很短，所以我昨天感觉很好。条件很艰苦，天气超级热，但我感觉很好。 “现在还早，还有一些锈迹需要去除，但昨天已经迈出了很好的一步。 “这是一次短暂的休息，可能比每个人都希望的要短，但我很高兴能回来，新赛季很快就会开始。”詹姆斯和其他在夏天随国家队参加世界杯后期的蓝军球员上周回到了科巴姆训练，阿隆索公开谈到了让我们的队长回到球队的重要性。 “这对于一位像他这样有能力的教练和前球员来说意义重大，”里斯回答道。 “这意义重大，所以希望我能为他付出一切，并在他最需要我的时候做出贡献。 “他们刚刚结束季前赛，这是很多旅行，很多比赛，但从我所看到的情况来看，每个人都适应得很好，我对这支球队感到很高兴。 “只有四五天，非常短，但到目前为止我非常享受，对于孩子们来说也是如此。”随着季前赛的结束，詹姆斯和切尔西下次上场将进行激烈的比赛，距离英超联赛开始还有一周时间。对于蓝军来说，这意味着 8 月 24 日星期一晚上在克雷文小屋迎战邻居富勒姆。 “对于我们的英超联赛来说，这是一场超级艰难的伦敦德比，但我们很兴奋，准备工作很快就会开始。我等不及了！

news.title: Xabi Alonso delighted to have ‘quality’ Reece James back
news.title_zh: 哈维·阿隆索很高兴“高品质”里斯·詹姆斯回归
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso was able to use Reece James for the first time in pre-season during our 3-1 defeat of Real Sociedad, and our manager explained why he is so pleased to have the Blues captain at his disposal. Having been a member of England’s squad which finished third at this summer’s World Cup, James only returned to training earlier this week. So Alonso has now had the chance to work with him on the pitches at Cobham, and see him in action from the touchline during a match. Our manager is well placed to outline the qualities James brings to the side. ‘Personality, leadership, experience, quality, composure with the ball, competitiveness without the ball,’ said Alonso. ‘He’s very flexible in his style and in different positions, he’s a legend in the club, and he is a key player for the team.’ James was not the only player to return to training this week. Like our skipper, new signings Maxence Lacroix and Morgan Rogers got an hour against Sociedad, with the latter opening the scoring in Saturday’s sunny victory in SW6. Alonso gave his verdict on those who were back on the pitch following their extended involvement at the World Cup. ‘They did quite well to play this well after just three days of training,’ said Alonso. ‘It’s early days and there is so much to connect and improve and live together, but the most important is the hunger and the desire they have to want to have a great season and create a good feeling in the team that will transmit to the rest. ‘Most of the players are fit to train. The fitness levels of some are higher than others after pre-season, but all of them will be good. We plan to have five training sessions before the Fulham game now and that’s the main focus.’
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索在季前赛以 3-1 击败皇家社会队的比赛中首次使用里斯·詹姆斯，我们的主教练解释了为什么他如此高兴蓝军队长可以为他所用。作为今年夏天世界杯上获得第三名的英格兰队的一员，詹姆斯在本周早些时候才恢复训练。因此，阿隆索现在有机会在科巴姆的球场上与他一起工作，并在比赛中在边线观看他的比赛。我们的经理非常有能力概述詹姆斯所带来的品质。 “个性、领导力、经验、素质、有球时的冷静、无球时的竞争力，”阿隆索说。 “他的风格非常灵活，在不同的位置上都非常灵活，他是俱乐部的传奇人物，也是球队的关键球员。”詹姆斯并不是本周唯一恢复训练的球员。和我们的队长一样，新加盟的马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦和摩根·罗杰斯在对阵皇家社会队的比赛中获得了一个小时的出场时间，后者在周六 SW6 的阳光明媚的胜利中首开纪录。阿隆索对那些长期参加世界杯后重返赛场的球员做出了评价。 “他们在仅仅三天的训练后就能打出这样的成绩，他们做得很好，”阿隆索说道。 “现在还处于早期阶段，有很多东西需要联系、改进和共同生活，但最重要的是他们的渴望和渴望，想要度过一个美好的赛季，并在球队中创造一种良好的感觉，这种感觉会传递给其他人。 “大多数球员都适合训练。季前赛结束后，有些人的体能水平比其他人要高，但所有人都会很好。我们计划在富勒姆比赛前进行五次训练，这是主要焦点。

news.title: Xabi Alonso on a productive final friendly and ‘emotional’ Stamford Bridge reception
news.title_zh: 哈维·阿隆索在斯坦福桥举办了富有成效的最后一场友谊赛和“激动人心的”招待会
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso was pleased with the effort his players put in against Real Sociedad in our final pre-season friendly of the summer, on a day when our new manager felt right at home at Stamford Bridge. The Blues defeated the side from San Sebastian 3-1, with Morgan Rogers opening his Chelsea account early on and Joao Pedro providing two typically clinical goals to seal the victory in the second half. Alonso was afforded the opportunity to use several members of his squad for the first time in pre-season, including the likes of Rogers, Maxence Lacroix and Reece James – all of whom went far at the FIFA World Cup. ‘It was a very good last preparation game,’ assessed Alonso afterwards. ‘For some players it was the first one and the last one. For us, there were some good things, some things we can improve. It’s normal at this moment for some players. ‘It was great to have all the team together. Some of them after three days could play for 60 minutes. It was the last test. Now we have a whole week to prepare for Fulham, but it was a good feeling in the stadium.’ Alonso admitted to being moved by the rapturous ovation he received from the Blues fans inside Stamford Bridge ahead of kick-off when he was introduced to the crowd at his first home game (pictured top). He knows how important the relationship between the team and Blues faithful will be, with the positive feeling today auguring well for the campaign ahead. ‘It was emotional to feel my first time in the new home,’ said Alonso. ‘A great reception from the supporters to the team and to the new staff, myself as well, so delighted. ‘We want to create good connections and have that support. We want to give them good football so they will give us energy, and we connect. To have a good atmosphere here in the stadium will be a massive boost for the team.’
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索对他的球员在今年夏天最后一场季前友谊赛对阵皇家社会队的比赛中所付出的努力感到满意，这一天我们的新主帅在斯坦福桥感到宾至如归。蓝军以 3-1 击败了圣塞巴斯蒂安队，摩根·罗杰斯早早打开了他的切尔西账户，而若奥·佩德罗则在下半场打进了两个典型的冷静进球，锁定了胜利。阿隆索在季前赛中首次有机会使用球队的几名球员，其中包括罗杰斯、马克斯森斯·拉克鲁瓦和里斯·詹姆斯等人——他们都在国际足联世界杯上走得很远。 “这是一场非常好的最后一场准备比赛，”阿隆索赛后评价道。 “对于一些球员来说，这是第一个也是最后一个。对我们来说，有一些好的事情，有一些我们可以改进的事情。对于某些玩家来说，此时这是正常的。 “所有团队聚集在一起真是太好了。有些人三天后就能玩60分钟。这是最后一次测试。现在我们有一整周的时间来为富勒姆做准备，但在球场里的感觉很好。”阿隆索承认，当他在第一场主场比赛中被介绍给观众时（上图），开球前斯坦福桥球场内蓝军球迷的热烈鼓掌令他感动不已。他知道球队和蓝军球迷之间的关系有多么重要，今天的积极情绪预示着接下来的赛季会有好结果。 “第一次来到新家的感觉很激动，”阿隆索说。 “支持者、球队和新员工以及我自己都受到了热烈的欢迎，非常高兴。 “我们希望建立良好的联系并获得这种支持。我们希望为他们提供精彩的足球，这样他们就会给我们能量，我们之间就会产生联系。体育场内良好的氛围将为球队带来巨大的推动力。”

news.title: Match report: Chelsea 3-1 Real Sociedad
news.title_zh: 比赛战报：切尔西 3-1 皇家社会
news.body_en: Morgan Rogers marked his first game in Chelsea colours with a goal and Joao Pedro added to his impressive summer tally by bagging a brace as Xabi Alonso’s Blues ended our pre-season schedule in style. On a sizzling summer’s afternoon in west London, Rogers poked us ahead early on after Joao Pedro’s header had been well saved. Sociedad carried a threat of their own and levelled shortly before the half-time whistle courtesy of Jon Mikel Aramburu’s fine volley. However, the second half was very much Chelsea’s, and our dominance was rewarded through a pair of Joao Pedro goals - his sixth and seventh of pre-season. The well-placed header that restored our lead arrived a couple of minutes into the second half, and the Brazilian backed that up by making a one-on-one opportunity look very easy as this enjoyable friendly entered its final act. Xabi Alonso, getting his first taste of the  home dugout at the Bridge, was able to give minutes to 20 of his players, including several who had yet to feature this pre-season. For the Blues fans watching on, it whet the appetite for what lies ahead, with the start of the Premier League campaign just over a week away now. Before kick-off, Alonso received a great ovation from the Chelsea supporters inside the stadium, and indeed the small pocket of travelling fans who saw him come through Real Sociedad’s ranks in the late nineties. Alonso’s first Stamford Bridge starting XI included new signings Marco Palestra, Maxence Lacroix and Rogers. The latter two were playing their first game for us having returned to training earlier in the week. The shape was nominally 3-4-3, with Pedro Neto and Palestra the wing-backs. Reece James joined Moises Caicedo in midfield, with Cole Palmer and Rogers – as well as Neto and Palestra – supporting Joao Pedro. It was apparent from the off how fluid the attack would be, with Joao Pedro regularly dropping deeper, allowing Rogers and Palmer to run beyond. However, it was from Joao Pedro’s positioning in a central striking position that we took the lead in the tenth minute. Neto teased a cross in from the right flank and the Brazilian’s header back across goal was well directed. Visiting keeper Alex Remiro, diving to his left, just reached it but succeeded only in teeing up Rogers, who couldn’t miss in front of the Shed. Joao Pedro almost immediately forced Remiro into another good save, with nobody in blue able to pick up the pieces on this occasion. Sociedad then threatened for the first time, Ander Barrenetxea cutting inside and curling a shot not far wide. Either side of a hydration break, which offered both teams some respite on another scorching London afternoon, Take Kubo shot into the side-netting and Rob Sanchez produced a superb reaction save to deny Jon Martin. It looked like we had quietened the Sociedad threat sufficiently before the break, but the side from San Sebastian equalised on the stroke of half-time through Arambaru’s brilliantly executed 20-yard volley. Sanchez stood no chance. The Blues came out of the blocks quickly and soon restored our lead, in similar fashion to the opener. Palmer twisted back and forth before laying the ball off for James to send over a right-wing cross. Joao Pedro rose highest and this time his header was steered beyond Remiro’s reach. Another attack involving Palmer ended with the Brazilian firing against Remiro’s legs as the angle narrowed, and there was plenty more slick interplay for the home fans to enjoy as we approached the hour mark. The first ranch of changes saw Mike Penders, Malo Gusto, Josh Acheampong and Enzo Fernandez enter the fray. Gusto went to right wing-back, with Neto switching to the left. One of Sociedad’s subs, Spain World Cup winner Mikel Oyarzabal, had a shot excellently blocked by Wesley Fofana shortly after coming on. But it was our leading man who was more decisive following another flurry of Blues subs – including a first sighting of Pep Chavarria in blue. Gusto played a fine through pass for Joao Pedro to run on to, and the confident finish that followed across Remiro felt inevitable. We continued to look threatening in the final quarter-hour, with Estevao shooting over and Jorrel Hato embarking on a lung-busting run from one end to the other that had the Blues fans roaring him on. It epitomised an enjoyable finale to pre-season. The Premier League season! The Blues begin the 2026/27 campaign by making the short trip to Craven Cottage to play Fulham next Monday 24 August. news.body_zh: 摩根·罗杰斯以进球标志着他在切尔西队的首场比赛，若昂·佩德罗则梅开二度，为他令人印象深刻的夏季进球增添了色彩，哈维·阿隆索的蓝军以时尚的方式结束了我们的季前赛。在伦敦西部一个炎热的夏日午后，若昂·佩德罗的头球被很好地扑出后，罗杰斯一早就为我们取得了领先。皇家社会队也构成了自己的威胁，并在半场结束前不久凭借乔恩·米克尔·阿兰布鲁的精彩抽射将比分扳平。然而，下半场很大程度上是切尔西的比赛，我们的统治地位通过若昂·佩德罗的两粒进球得到了回报——这是他季前赛的第六粒和第七粒进球。下半场开始几分钟后，巴西人的头球定位得当，帮助我们恢复了领先优势，而巴西人则在这场令人愉快的友谊赛进入最后一幕时，轻松地创造了一对一的机会。哈维·阿隆索第一次在蓝桥尝到了主场的滋味，他给了 20 名球员上场时间，其中包括几名尚未在季前赛上场的球员。对于正在观看的蓝军球迷来说，这激发了他们对未来的兴趣，距离英超联赛的开始只有一周多了。开球前，阿隆索受到了球场内切尔西球迷的热烈鼓掌，甚至还有一小部分在上世纪九十年代末看到他在皇家社会队中崭露头角的客场球迷。阿隆索在斯坦福桥的首发阵容包括新签约的马科·帕莱斯特拉、马克斯森斯·拉克鲁瓦和罗杰斯。后两人是我们在本周早些时候恢复训练后的第一场比赛。名义上的阵型是3-4-3，佩德罗·内托和帕莱斯特拉担任边后卫。里斯·詹姆斯与莫伊塞斯·凯塞多一起出任中场，科尔·帕尔默和罗杰斯以及内托和帕莱斯特拉为若昂·佩德罗提供支持。从一开始就可以看出进攻的流畅性，若昂·佩德罗经常回撤更深，让罗杰斯和帕尔默跑得更远。然而，正是由于若奥·佩德罗在中路的位置，我们在第10分钟取得了领先。内托从右翼挑传，巴西人的头球攻门精准。来访的守门员亚历克斯·雷米罗（Alex Remiro）向他的左侧猛扑，刚刚到达球门，但只成功地将罗杰斯（Rogers）开球，而罗杰斯（Rogers）在棚屋前不能错过。若昂·佩德罗几乎立即迫使雷米罗做出了另一次精彩扑救，这次蓝衣无人能收拾残局。随后，社会队首次发起威胁，安德·巴雷内特西亚内切，一脚弧线射门偏出。在另一个炎热的伦敦下午，补水休息为两支球队提供了一些喘息的机会，久保建的射门打入边网，罗布·桑切斯做出了精彩的扑救，挡出了乔恩·马丁的球门。看起来我们在中场休息前已经充分平息了皇家社会的威胁，但圣塞巴斯蒂安队在半场结束前通过阿兰巴鲁出色的 20 码凌空抽射扳平了比分。桑切斯没有机会。蓝军很快就走出了禁区，很快就恢复了领先优势，就像揭幕战一样。帕尔默前后转身，然后将球传给詹姆斯，后者传出右翼传中。若昂·佩德罗（Joao Pedro）最高，这一次他的头球超出了雷米罗的范围。帕尔默的另一次进攻以巴西人在角度缩小时向雷米罗的腿开火而告终，当我们接近一小时时，主场球迷可以享受更多流畅的互动。第一个变化是迈克·潘德斯 (Mike Penders)、马洛·古斯托 (Malo Gusto)、乔什·阿奇姆彭 (Josh Acheampong) 和恩佐·费尔南德斯 (Enzo Fernandez) 加入了竞争。古斯托出任右翼卫，内托则换到左翼。皇家社会队的一名替补球员、西班牙世界杯冠军米克尔·奥亚萨瓦尔上场后不久，他的一脚射门被韦斯利·福法纳出色地挡出。但在另一波蓝军替补到来之后，我们的领军人物变得更加果断——其中包括第一次看到身着蓝色球衣的佩普·查瓦里亚（Pep Chavarria）。古斯托为若昂·佩德罗送出了一记漂亮的直塞球，让他继续跑动，随后越过雷米罗的自信射门感觉是不可避免的。在最后一刻钟里，我们继续保持着威胁，埃斯特沃射门高出，乔雷尔·哈托从一端跑到另一端，让蓝军球迷为他欢呼。它是季前赛令人愉快的结局的缩影。英超赛季！蓝军将在 8 月 24 日下周一短暂前往克雷文小屋迎战富勒姆，以此开启 2026/27 赛季的征程。 news.body_en: Morgan Rogers and Maxence Lacroix play their first games in Chelsea blue as we welcome Real Sociedad to Stamford Bridge for our final pre-season friendly. It is also the day Xabi Alonso sits in the home dugout at the Bridge for the first time, and our new manager has selected Rogers, Lacroix and another new signing, Marco Palestra, in today’s XI. There are also starts for Cole Palmer, Pedro Neto and Joao Pedro, with Reece James captaining and expected to join Moises Caicedo in midfield. Rob Sanchez is between the posts. Valentin Barco and Pep Chavarria are named on the bench and could play their first Chelsea game today. Today's match will be available to watch live on the Chelsea Official App and Chelsea website with a CFC+ subscription. You can sign up here! Please note the stream will not be shown in Spain. Chelsea: Sanchez; Fofana, Lacroix, Colwill, Palestra, James (c), Caicedo, Neto, Palmer, Rogers, Joao Pedro. Chelsea substitutes: Penders, Slonina, Acheampong, Chavarria, Gusto, Hato, Barco, Essugo, Fernandez, Lavia, Quenda, Estevao Willian, Gittens Real Sociedad: Remiro, Aramburu, Barrenetxea (c), Oskarsson, Herrera, Take Kubo, Gomez, Soler, Suci, Martin, Beitia Substitutes: Marrero, Folgago, Munoz, Zubeldia, Turrientes, Oyarzabal, Marin, Zakharyan, Goti, Ruperez, Ochieng, Marchal, Lebarbier
news.body_zh: 摩根·罗杰斯 (Morgan Rogers) 和马克斯森斯·拉克鲁瓦 (Maxence Lacroix) 身穿切尔西蓝色球衣参加了他们的第一场比赛，我们欢迎皇家社会队来到斯坦福桥参加最后一场季前友谊赛。这也是哈维·阿隆索第一次坐在蓝桥主教练席上的日子，我们的新主帅选择了罗杰斯、拉克鲁瓦和另一位新援马尔科·帕莱斯特拉进入今天的首发阵容。科尔·帕尔默、佩德罗·内托和若昂·佩德罗也首发，里斯·詹姆斯担任队长，预计将与莫伊塞斯·凯塞多一起担任中场。罗布·桑切斯在两个门柱之间。瓦伦丁·巴科和佩普·查瓦里亚被任命为替补，今天他们将参加切尔西的首场比赛。订阅 CFC+ 即可在切尔西官方应用程序和切尔西网站上观看今天的比赛直播。您可以在这里注册！请注意，该直播不会在西班牙播放。切尔西：桑切斯；福法纳、拉克鲁瓦、科尔威尔、帕莱斯特拉、詹姆斯（c）、凯塞多、内托、帕尔默、罗杰斯、若昂·佩德罗。切尔西替补：彭德斯、斯洛尼纳、阿奇姆蓬、查瓦里亚、古斯托、哈托、巴科、埃苏戈、费尔南德斯、拉维亚、昆达、埃斯特沃·威廉、吉滕斯 皇家社会：雷米罗、阿兰布鲁、巴雷内特西亚（中）、奥斯卡森、埃雷拉、久保久保、戈麦斯、索莱尔、苏西、马丁、贝蒂亚 替补：马雷罗、福尔加戈、穆尼奥斯、祖贝尔迪亚、图连特斯、奥亚萨瓦尔、马林、扎卡扬、戈蒂、鲁佩雷斯、奥钦、马夏尔、勒巴比尔
